notes: PNG bytes and alpha are unchanged from the selected ImageGen output; no raster editing was performed.
Visible bounds include alpha >= 32. Named rectangles add eight pixels padding and contain every visible pixel; no visible sprite touches a rectangle edge.
Guardians extend slightly above the notional lower-row boundary; consume these rectangles rather than automatic square cells.
All four source sprites face left; mirror the complete sprite around its anchor when facing right.
This atlas contains four poses, one per species. Motion and attack telegraphs are supplied by the game renderer and logic.
